point: Reliability issues (body roll, transmission, oil leaks) are decisive
quote: Common faults include issues with body roll, transmission troubles, oil leaks, wheel alignment faults, and random squeaks and rattles.

point: Real‑world fuel consumption of plug‑in hybrids is a key metric
quote: Real‑world fuel consumption of plug‑in hybrids is about three times higher than official test values.

point: Regional average mileage informs typical usage trends
quote: Graf ukazuje, jak průměrně ojetá auta jsou auta při návštěvě STK v každém kraji.

point: VIN and technical certificate verification is essential
quote: Technical certificate: check the VIN, engine number, colour and first registration date against the car.

point: Continuous service book entries indicate proper maintenance
quote: Service book and invoices: look for a continuous date and mileage sequence, not just a stamp.

point: Recent roadworthiness test record must be confirmed
quote: Recent roadworthiness test record: ask for the date and the result, then check the official source.

point: Annual running cost helps assess price/value ratio
quote: Skoda Citigo (Hatchback) would cost around £856.10 per year, based on 7500 miles annually.

point: Adjust manufacturer fuel figures by adding two litres for realism
quote: Adding two to a manufacturer’s claimed fuel consumption number will provide a more accurate estimation.

point: Low mileage and thorough maintenance boost vehicle value
quote: Toyota Corolla Hatchback SE is economically and environmentally smart with low mileage and exacting maintenance program.

point: Best deal focus drives price/value assessment
quote: You don’t want to buy a car - you want to get the best deal on the car you’re looking for.
